title: tooling(objectui-readiness 2): scripts, tests and e2e specs that read pnpm-workspace.yaml, turbo.json, pnpm-lock.yaml or root overrides at the objectui root resolve the workspace root upward (parent #25677, 2b/6)
body:
Filing gate ④: sub-issue 2b/6 of the epic #25677 (`pm:epic`; epic PM `session_01RSDL3SFtJaKzcymvCD8RsU`). Part of #25677. ⛔ Not a claim. Follow-up of #25685 (objectui#13472), measured on the first CI run of the `DO NOT MERGE` verification PR #25710 → #25718 (run 40144323591, head b2ba3a42da).

**Why a second readiness card.** #25685 rooted "where is the objectui tree" on `scripts/ui-root.mjs` and removed the `.git` / `pnpm-workspace.yaml` marker walks. The import also **deletes or moves four files at that root**, and the readers of those files were not in #25685's scope: `pnpm-workspace.yaml` (deleted — a nested workspace root is ignored), `turbo.json` (parked — a nested `turbo.json` must `extends` the root), `pnpm-lock.yaml` (deleted — one lockfile at the git root) and the root `package.json`'s `pnpm.overrides` / `patchedDependencies` (moved to the git-root manifest). On the merged tree those readers are the first red in **Type Check UI**, **Build & E2E UI** and **Test UI**, before the type-check, e2e or component tests run. Until they are fixed, the cutover PR cannot be measured and the three jobs cannot go green.

**Who does it, where it lands:** the epic PM dispatches it (os-dev, objectui checkout). One PR to **objectstack-ai/objectui `main`** before cutover, inert for the standalone layout (every reader keeps answering exactly what it answers today when the file is at the objectui root). The epic PM also applies the same patch as a verify-only commit on the verification branch to re-measure the three jobs.

## 维护者速读

#25685 已经把"objectui 树在哪"统一到 `scripts/ui-root.mjs`,但导入时还会**删掉或挪走 objectui 根目录的四个文件**:`pnpm-workspace.yaml`(嵌套的工作区根会被忽略)、`turbo.json`(嵌套 turbo.json 必须 `extends` 根)、`pnpm-lock.yaml`(全仓一个锁文件)、根 `package.json` 里的 `pnpm.overrides` / `patchedDependencies`(并入根清单)。读这四个文件的脚本、测试和 e2e 用例在合并树上第一个变红:验证分支首轮 CI 里 Type Check UI 在 `check:side-effects-array` 就停、Build & E2E UI 在第一个 e2e 文件就停、Test UI 已跑完的 6 片各挂 5–6 个文件,全是同一类原因。本卡只做一件事:这些读取器改为"objectui 根有这个文件就读它,没有就向上一层读 objectstack 根的,并按 `ui/` 前缀过滤",独立仓行为不变。objectui 这边一个 PR,切换前合;不改受管面。

## Measured on the merged tree (run 40144323591)

| Job | Where it stopped | Reader |
|---|---|---|
| Type Check UI | `pnpm --dir ui run check:side-effects-array` | `scripts/check-side-effects-array.mjs:282` reads `<root>/pnpm-workspace.yaml` |
| Build & E2E UI | `e2e/record-header-title-width.spec.ts:65` ENOENT `<git root>/packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailView.tsx` | `REPO_ROOT` IIFE walks up to the first `pnpm-workspace.yaml` = objectstack's root. Same IIFE in `dashboard-metric-tile-height`, `sidebar-offcanvas-geometry`, `studio-item-header-title-width`, `toast-under-modal`. `check-ui-root-lookups` is SILENT on a `readFileSync` of the marker, so this probe shape escaped #25685. |
| Test UI 9/16 | ENOENT `ui/pnpm-workspace.yaml` | `scripts/__tests__/check-side-effects-array.test.ts` (5), `zero-test-member-exclusion-9106.test.ts`, `packages/cli/src/__tests__/workspace-vite.test.ts` (4), `app-shell/.../CreateViewDialog.chartBinding-11576.test.tsx` |
| Test UI 9/16 | ENOENT `ui/turbo.json` | `scripts/select-type-check-scope.mjs` via its test; `scripts/__tests__/turbo-lint-inputs.test.ts` (shard 1) |
| Test UI 1/16 | "the stub did not serve this run — a live pnpm reached the registry" ×10 | `scripts/__tests__/check-lockfile-dedupe.test.ts` — `check-lockfile-dedupe.mjs` resolves the lockfile / runs pnpm at `uiRoot()`, where no lockfile exists |
| Test UI 1/16 | 3 failures | `scripts/__tests__/react-peer-range-norm-3741.test.ts` — overrides now live in the git-root manifest |

Other readers of the same files on `main` (not yet reached by CI, same fix): `scripts/check-docs-route-eager-closure.mjs:204`, `scripts/select-affected-tests.mjs:186`, `scripts/release-github-releases.mjs`, `scripts/check-lockfile-integrity.mjs`, `scripts/check-installed-spec-pin-claims.mjs`, `scripts/dependabot-merge-gate.mjs`, `scripts/check-new-cross-file-line-citations.mjs` / `cross-file-line-citation-census.mjs`, `scripts/dollar-dialect-alias-census.mjs`. `packages/cli/src/utils/workspace-vite.ts` and `app-generator.ts` ask about the USER's cwd (product behaviour, allowlisted in `check-ui-root-lookups`) and are **out of scope**; only their tests, which read this repo's manifest, are in.

## Scope

1. **One helper, Node builtins only** (it must be importable before `pnpm install`, like `ui-root.mjs`): `scripts/workspace-root.mjs` (name is the dev's) answering (a) `workspaceRoot()` — `uiRoot()` when `<uiRoot>/pnpm-workspace.yaml` exists, else `path.resolve(uiRoot(), '..')` when THAT holds one, else throw; (b) `workspaceGlobs()` — the `packages:` globs of that file, and when the root is the parent, only the globs under `ui/` with the prefix stripped (the bare `ui` entry is the objectui root itself and is dropped); (c) `lockfilePath()`, `rootManifest()` (the manifest whose `pnpm` block holds overrides / patchedDependencies) on the same rule. Each reader above imports the helper instead of joining `uiRoot()` (or a walk) with the file name. The three existing ad-hoc `packages:` parsers (`check-side-effects-array`, `select-affected-tests`, `check-docs-route-eager-closure`) become one parser with their union of refusals kept.
2. **`turbo.json` readers** (`select-type-check-scope.mjs`, `turbo-lint-inputs.test.ts`): read the nearest `turbo.json` upward (`uiRoot()` then the parent) and tolerate the parent's `$TURBO_ROOT$/ui/`-re-rooted inputs (objectstack#25710 re-roots objectui's repo-root inputs that way). Where a test pins objectui's own task shapes, it reads the parked copy `turbo.objectui.json` when `turbo.json` is absent at `uiRoot()` — the dev states which.
3. **The five e2e `REPO_ROOT` IIFEs** → `uiRoot()` (the specs read source files under `packages/`, so the objectui root is the right answer).
4. **`check-ui-root-lookups`** learns the escaped shape: a `readFileSync` / `existsSync` of a marker inside a loop that reassigns its directory to `path.dirname(...)` is a root lookup, not a data read. Self-test cases: the e2e IIFE (fires), the data read at a known root (still silent).
5. **Tests that build fixtures** of a workspace root keep working: a fixture that writes its own `pnpm-workspace.yaml` is a root by rule (a) — the helper takes an optional explicit root for exactly that.

Out of scope (cutover adaptation commit, sub-issue 5, tracked on #25697): dropping the turbo-recursive scripts from `ui/package.json`; `QUICK_REFERENCE.md`'s "Current Release" block stating `workspace:^`; the dom-test failures not attributed to a reader (`ListView.fieldListRead-11984`, `importWriteModes-12697`, `ImportWizard.csvFileSource-13315`) — re-measured after this card's patch is on the verification branch.

## Verification (the dev's)

- Standalone: `pnpm check:ui-root-lookups` (with the new case), the whole `scripts/__tests__` suite, `pnpm --filter @object-ui/cli test`, `pnpm check:side-effects-array`, `pnpm check:docs-route-eager-closure`, `pnpm check:lockfile-dedupe`, `pnpm check:lockfile-integrity`, `pnpm type-check:scripts`, `pnpm type-check:e2e`, `pnpm lint:coverage`. All green, no gate skipped.
- Merged layout, locally: a scratch copy of the objectstack verification worktree with this branch's `ui/` and the four files absent/parked as the adaptation leaves them — `pnpm --dir ui run check:side-effects-array` exits 0, `pnpm --dir ui run test -- <the failing files above>` green, `pnpm --dir ui exec playwright test --list` resolves every spec (no ENOENT before the browser starts).
- The epic PM re-runs the three jobs on #25718 with the patch as a verify commit and records the reds that remain on #25697.

## Done when

- PR merged on objectui `main`; `git grep -n "pnpm-workspace.yaml\|pnpm-lock.yaml\|'turbo.json'" scripts packages/cli/src e2e` shows only the helper, the allowlisted cwd predicates and comments.
- On the verification branch: Type Check UI reaches "Run type-check over the ui packages", Build & E2E UI reaches the browser, Test UI's reader failures are gone.

**Size:** M — one helper, ~20 call sites, 5 e2e files, one gate case. **Clause-②:** no. **Metadata-protocol:** none.

## 风险

- A helper that silently picks the parent root in the standalone layout would hide a deleted file; rule (a) prefers the objectui root and throws when neither holds the file.
- `select-type-check-scope` reading the merged `turbo.json` sees objectstack tasks too; it must select from the ui subset only (filter on `ui/` paths), or the scope it computes widens to the whole repo.

## Dedupe

Open issues 2026-10-25 00:05Z filtered on workspace / ui-root / readiness / pnpm-workspace: #25685 (closed, scope = marker walks, not file readers) and this epic's own cards. **New.**
